Sound familiar?

You want to learn.
But you still have questions.

Finding content is easy. Finding the right help can take more work.

01

You get stuck watching a video.

You replay the same part, but it does not explain the step you missed. You want to ask someone to show it another way.

02

A title sounds interesting, but you need to know the level, what you will practise, and whether you have the right experience.

03

Watch a demonstration. Ask a question. Try it yourself.
Why learn live?

Get an explanation
when you need one.

In a live program, you can ask your provider about the part you do not understand. That conversation can help you work out what to try next.

talent-share brings people who want to learn, called seekers, together with people who teach, called providers. Choose a program based on your interests, experience, and the time you can commit.

What happens after you book

Spend your time learning,
with the details organised.

Your program page keeps the session schedule, shared resources, and conversations together. For online programs, it is also where you join the live video session.

  • Ask during the session or follow up in the program discussion.
  • Return to the resources your provider has shared.

Before you decide

A few practical
questions.

Check the format, costs, and commitment before choosing your program.

All questions and answers↗
Are these live programs or recorded videos?

Programs are taught live, either online or in person. Online sessions run in talent-share’s video room, with camera, microphone, screen sharing, and session chat. Providers may also share supporting resources, including videos, in the program’s file library.

Do I need an account to look at a program?

You can read public program pages before signing in. Booking requires an account. The classroom, program files, announcements, and program discussion are available to confirmed seekers and the provider.

How much does a program cost?

Each provider sets the program price. Checkout shows the program price and service fee separately, along with the total, before you pay. Your receipt uses the same breakdown. Check the selected program for its current price.

Can I book just one date in a repeating program?

When a program is offered on several start dates, you book the date selected in the booking card. Check the full schedule for that selection: a single booking may include multiple sessions. Other start dates are separate bookings.

Can I cancel a booking?

You can request a cancellation within 24 hours of enrolling if the first session is still at least 24 hours away. Requests are subject to platform approval. Check the current policy in the app before booking and contact support if you need help.
